column1: # The consumers of shared platform vector tables (ADR-0125 addendum (5); ACC-VECTORS-CONNECT-02/03/04).
# One row per unique (package, table, lesson). package is the full (common|NN-name)/name path without vectors/; table is its file name; lesson is the directory of Platform/lessons.tsv.
# The consumers are these explicit rows plus the owner lesson of a lesson-local package; common has no implicit lesson.
# Duplicate (package, table, lesson), unknown lesson, package or table is a form error.
# A row assigns a TABLE, not every input/output of it: row/operation/direction/field selections remain those of the package README named by norm.
# No row turns an existing byte carrier, signer, writer-only role or ready-result reader into a caller of a different function.
# family-read assigns NN.tsv only to its owner lesson NN. No common vectors are assigned to the published byte module 07-console-module.
